reuse.why: Follows the existing ensureBankAccountNotLinked guard pattern in the handler wrappers and the existing error-constant convention; the guard re-queries the account that each link* function also loads, rather than sharing that lookup.

duplication.why: The closed check lives in one helper; only the one-line guard call is repeated across the six provider wrappers, mirroring the existing duplicate-link guard.

placement.why: Validation sits in the handler wrappers of accounts/app.ts next to the existing pre-link validation, before any side effects.

scope.why: Only the new guard, its six call sites and focused tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Clear, small helper consistent with existing code; a combined pre-link validation wrapper would avoid having to remember two guard calls in each new provider handler.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six *-accounts-link handlers call the new ensureAccountIsOpen alongside ensureBankAccountNotLinked; fintegra delegates to the akahu path but is guarded in its own handler.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; the guard is a single shared function.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpen in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every provider link handler (the only server entry points taking upgradingId).
